name: Generalized Stokes' Theorem
statement: Let \(M\) be an orientable \(n\)-manifold, and let \(\omega\) be a smooth \((n-1)\)-form on \(M\). Then \[ \int_{M}\mathrm{d}\omega=\int_{\partial M}\omega.\]

name: Yoneda's Lemma
statement:
Let \( \mathcal{C} \) be a locally small category, let \( \mathcal{S}et \) be the category of sets, and let \( F : \mathcal{C}\to\mathcal{S}et \) be any functor. Then for all objects \( x\in\mathcal{C}\), there is an isomorphism of sets (i.e. a bijection)
\[
\varphi_x : \operatorname{Nat}(\mathcal{C}(x,-),F)\cong F(x),
\]
natural in \( x \).

name: Fermat's Little Theorem
statement:
Let \( p \) be a prime, and let \( a \) be an integer not divisible by \( p \). Then
\[
a^{p-1} \equiv 1 \pmod{p}.
\]
